responsibility: Implements the tree/IPA-side profiling pass that instruments functions for gcov-style edge and value profiling, reads profile data back, and applies related profile-driven GIMPLE transformations. It creates gcov runtime decls and TLS globals for indirect-call/time profiling, inserts profiling code into function bodies and thunks, updates CFG/SSA and callgraph state after instrumentation, rebuilds call edges, and coordinates profile generation, use, and coverage filtering across the callgraph.
